status: DRAFT - not signed, not on the blackboard, not approved for any run
drafted_by: Claude (session v117-c3c5); every number below is to be computed by code, none is filled in here
model_code: iap.alpha.linear_v2 (LinearAlphaV2; the registered linear_z_v1 classes in iap.alpha.base / equity / fx are untouched)
hypothesis: On the multi7 in-sample sessions, the per-instrument causally standardised twins (EQ05_z2, EQ10_z2) have a fold-mean gate IC at least as high as their linear_z_v1 originals (EQ05, EQ10) at the same horizons, and the share of rows with confidence >= conf_min is no longer set by one instrument: the per-instrument confident-row shares differ by less than 0.10 between the most and the least active name.
dataset: data/real/multi7 (in-sample days of research/r7/r7_candidates.json); no holdout day is read by this draft

protocol.gate: iap.validation.metrics.gate_statistics on the uncrossed rows, per-instrument scaling, HAC auto bandwidth, day-separated; the day-cluster t reported beside it
protocol.looks: one validation per candidate and per baseline (4 x looks_per_validation(4)); the baselines' existing reports are reused where their experiment ids match, else re-run and debited

rules: max over instruments of confident_row_share - min over instruments < 0.10 for each candidate
hypothesis_confirmed (beta > 0 in >= 70 % of folds) for each candidate
acceptance.unit: per candidate; the hypothesis holds only if every candidate passes

what_this_does_not_claim: no promotion, no holdout read, no change to any registered alpha's fingerprint; a pass makes linear_z_v2 the standardisation for the C8 breadth book pre-registration, which is its own document
open_for_owner: approve the candidate pair and the 30m window before any run
sign-off and blackboard registration (WriteBroker.preregister) before the first look
